title: tracker-screenshot-browser
responsibility: Opens an owned tab in the dedicated automation Chrome and exposes viewport PNGs, coordinate clicks, ordinary text entry and tab teardown.

inputs.name: openScreenshotBrowser.origin
inputs.description: A canonical HTTPS origin without a path, query, fragment, or user information. HTTP is accepted for local loopback fixtures at 127.0.0.1.

outputs.name: openScreenshotBrowser
outputs.description: A session with screenshot, click, type and close methods bound to the new tab. The screenshot method returns PNG bytes and the other methods return no data.

errors.name: ScreenshotBrowserError
errors.description: Rejects with a fixed error when origin validation, tab creation, connection, navigation or teardown during setup fails. Browser-provided payloads are omitted.
